description: Plan A2: the authored valley inside the first 192 by 192 tile mountain ring.

props.note: Bridge, fire, bell, cut in a row. Under the bell, a lantern facing the hills.
An iron lantern post, turned to the town. Paving stones at its feet.
Cut deep: "By day the rubble, by night the way."
A stone lantern, its fire bowl facing the hills, where the mist comes from. Soft earth below.
